movie.title: Just Play Dead
movie.overview: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Cornered by the Feds, a wealthy criminal plans to fake his own death for a $30 million insurance payout, only to enter a deadly battle of wits with his wife, who intends to kill him for real.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When wealthy criminal mastermind Jack Wolfe is backed into a corner by federal agents, he devises a plan to fake his death and split a $30 million life insurance policy with his wife, Nora. However, Nora secretly plots to eliminate Jack permanently and frame her lover Chad to claim the entire fortune for herself. As their mutual betrayals collide, Jack and Nora engage in a high-stakes psychological war to outsmart one another. Ultimately, their tangled web of lies turns a fake murder scheme into a lethal game of survival.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Facing imminent capture by federal authorities, wealthy criminal mastermind Jack Wolfe orchestrates an elaborate scheme to fake his own murder. His plan relies on his seemingly devoted wife, Nora, to claim a massive $30 million life insurance payout while scapegoating her surfer lover, Chad, for the crime. Unbeknownst to Jack, Nora has her own ruthless agenda and sees this as the perfect opportunity to cut him out of the equation entirely. She decides to actually murder Jack during the execution of the scam, ensuring she keeps the entire payout for herself while leaving Chad to take the fall. However, Jack is far too paranoid to trust Nora completely and anticipates her betrayal, leading to a tense showdown between the spouses. As their competing schemes implode, Chad becomes an unwitting pawn trapped between two manipulative sociopaths. Deceptions are exposed, alliances shift rapidly, and every calculated move escalates the violence. With federal agents closing in on the wreckage, Nora and Jack push each other to absolute extremes in a desperate bid for freedom and wealth. In the end, their twisted game of lethal brinkmanship leaves a trail of destruction where only one can truly escape alive.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Just Play Dead is a tense psychological thriller centered on Jack Wolfe, a wealthy criminal mastermind who finds himself cornered by the Feds. To escape prison and secure his future, Jack devises a audacious scheme to fake his own death, planning to collect a $30 million life insurance payout alongside his wife, Nora, while setting up her surfer lover, Chad, as the fall guy. However, Nora is harboring her own dangerous ambitions and decides that killing Jack for real is a much more lucrative option. As husband and wife attempt to outmaneuver each other in a deadly contest of deceit, secret motives collide, trust evaporates, and a routine insurance scam devolves into a desperate, high-stakes game of survival where only the most ruthless partner will prevail.

story_structure.climax: The mutual deception reaches a boiling point in a final confrontation where Jack and Nora's deadly traps converge, forcing a definitive showdown between the spouses.
story_structure.conflict: While Jack plans to frame Nora's lover, Chad, for the fake murder, Nora secretly plots to double-cross Jack by killing him for real, framing Chad, and claiming the entire payout for herself.
story_structure.resolution: The aftermath of the violent clash reveals who successfully navigated the lethal web of betrayal and secured the fortune, bringing the deadly cat-and-mouse game to a conclusion.
story_structure.introduction: Jack Wolfe, a wealthy criminal mastermind, faces imminent arrest by federal agents and devises an elaborate scheme with his wife, Nora, to fake his death and claim a $30 million life insurance payout.
story_structure.risingAction: As both schemes are set in motion, hidden motives begin to emerge and lies unravel, forcing Jack and Nora into a high-stakes battle of wits to outsmart and eliminate each other.
